name: Assamite Sorcery (Whispers of the Heavens) — 3 Advanced — Ripples on the Sea of Stars

system.description:
The pinnacle of Whispers of the Heavens casts the sorcerer's awareness far from her body, using the night sky itself as a scrying pool. She may observe any event occurring beneath the same stars she can see, provided she is at least casually familiar with a participant, location or object central to the scene. The scene must be occurring under open night sky — the power fails outright by day or indoors.

System: The player wins a Mental challenge (difficulty reduced if the sorcerer has scried the same target before); the margin of success determines the clarity of the vision, from a dim glimpse, up to full sensory perception, the ability to bring Auspex or other sorcery powers to bear on the distant scene, and at the highest tiers even limited mystic influence over it. While using this power the sorcerer suffers a penalty to any action requiring her to interact with her immediate physical surroundings. Any observed subject who possesses Auspex senses a faint watching presence from above, though not enough to identify the sorcerer.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book Two: Saracens
